scope: Canonical front-view modular body: footwear heel openings, hidden rear straps, calf coverage, trouser hems, hat crowns and hair/skin occlusion.
method: Native SVG registration, source-coordinate deletion masks and depth/coverage rules. Existing painted PNGs and catalogue colours/textiles are preserved; no generated or pixel-edited source images.

repairs.change: Right heel moved 52 canonical pixels left onto the ankle; hidden back arcs removed while retaining front bands, side straps and buckles.
Hidden rear ankle-band arc removed from equipped view; front band and vertical strap remain.
Small rear heel-strap segment removed where the ankle occupies the source opening.
Upper empty collar segments removed; calf and ankle-bridge skin masked inside shafts. Upper shafts tuck beneath long trouser hems, but remain visible with skirts and shorts.
Product thumbnail widened to 170 1230 680 230, retaining both complete toes, soles and heels.
Crown raised without clipping the top of the source painting: translate(261.12 -56) scale(.49 .29). Brim clears the eyes.
Restored crown height: translate(199.68 -89) scale(.61 .34). Style-specific afro tuck keeps the painting's natural side outline.
Buzz-cut-specific compact fit: translate(307.2 -64) scale(.4 .27). Product registration and other hairstyles are unchanged.
Removed whole-head 25% clipping. Hair tucks independently, upper scalp trims only the top 24/240 pixels, and forehead, brows and eyes remain available beneath curved hat openings.

verification: Every source was visually inspected equipped and as a product. Repaired sandal openings were checked on all three skin buckets. All footwear families were checked with long trouser hems. Live wardrobe used temporary catalogue try-on only, then restored the original worn outfit; Mia and 156 coins were retained.
limitations: This pass audits the existing stationary front-view attachment rig. It does not add rear-view, profile-view or animated footwear/headwear sprite sets. Baseline and intermediate screenshots are retained separately and are not final approvals.
